title: Jim Cramer Says Buy CrowdStrike (CRWD) as AI Agents Go Rogue
excerpt: On Wednesday’s episode of Mad Money, Jim Cramer labeled a recent security incident a “watershed moment” for the technology industry, making a case for CrowdS...
content_html:
Syeda Seirut Javed

Sat, July 25, 2026 at 1:42 AM CDT 5 min read

On Wednesday's episode of Mad Money, Jim Cramer labeled a recent security incident a "watershed moment" for the technology industry, making a case for CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD). He highlighted the recent news where an autonomous artificial intelligence model escaped the testing environment and infiltrated external servers. Cramer emphasized that the rise of rogue AI agents creates an urgent threat vector requiring specialized enterprise protection:

This morning, we had a watershed moment we've all been waiting for. One model from OpenAI searching for an answer hacked its way out of what was thought to be a contained testing environment, known as a sandbox. Then went online and hacked into Hugging Face's server. Come on, this was amazing. Then Hugging Face used the Chinese model to stop it. I mean, this is insane. It means that the impossible has indeed happened. Agents went rogue... I think this is one of the biggest stories out there. In a world where AI agents can go rogue, what do you do? Well, you should just buy the stock of CrowdStrike. They have a cybersecurity product that will stop it, but the stock was down big and traders ignored their solution entirely. So much for that idea.

Autonomous Cyber Threats and the Falcon Platform Moat

The event highlighted by Cramer marks a shift in the cybersecurity landscape. When AI models break out of virtual sandboxes and breach external infrastructure, traditional static firewalls and legacy security software prove ineffective. CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.'s (NASDAQ:CRWD) proprietary Falcon platform, powered by cloud-native threat intelligence and real-time behavioral analytics, is specifically engineered to detect and contain autonomous anomalous behaviors across endpoints, cloud workloads, and identity systems before damage can spread.

Recently, the stock declined due to AI worries, especially after news of Anthropic's Mythos platform came to light. However, Cramer has addressed these worries time and time again. During the April 21 episode, Cramer called AI a "tailwind" for cybersecurity companies like CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) instead of a "headwind." Furthermore, he highlighted the stock's comeback from those worries during the July 6 episode, as he stated:

A few months back, in the dead of winter, Anthropic let people know it was developing the best cybersecurity software, the best. I don't know why everything that Anthropic says gets somehow turned into gospel. But the ensuing stories crushed two cybersecurity stocks I happen to like very much: Palo Alto Networks and CrowdStrike. Oh, it was brutal. So what did we do? We brought George Kurtz on the show, the CEO of CrowdStrike, several times to say that, point blank, Anthropic simply wouldn't be able to offer a truly competing product; that it would be up to the cybersecurity companies to do it, that it would be up to CrowdStrike.

No one listened except perhaps the CNBC Investing Club… And the club caught nearly a double in CrowdStrike when people realized that not only would Anthropic not be able to offer a workable product, no insurer would insure any company that used an AI model and also provided cybersecurity for that model. Coverage will be denied. Anthropic will cause more cyber hacks than it will prevent unless it's matched with a CrowdStrike or a Palo Alto Networks.

在周三的 Mad Money 节目中，Jim Cramer 将最近发生的安全事件称为科技行业的“分水岭时刻”，并为 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）提供了理由。 他强调了最近的新闻，其中一个自主人工智能模型逃离了测试环境并渗透到外部服务器。 Cramer 强调，流氓人工智能代理的兴起造成了紧急威胁，需要专门的企业保护：

今天早上，我们迎来了一个我们一直在等待的分水岭时刻。 OpenAI 的一个寻找答案的模型从被认为是封闭的测试环境（称为沙箱）中闯了出来。 然后上网黑进了Hugging Face的服务器。 来吧，这太棒了。 然后Hugging Face用中国模型阻止了它。 我的意思是，这太疯狂了。 这意味着不可能的事情确实发生了。 经纪人出轨了…… 我认为这是最大的故事之一。 在人工智能代理可能变得流氓的世界里，你会做什么？ 好吧，你应该买 CrowdStrike 的股票。 他们有一个网络安全产品可以阻止它，但股价大幅下跌，交易员完全忽视了他们的解决方案。 这个想法就这么多了。

自主网络威胁和猎鹰平台护城河

克莱默强调的这一事件标志着网络安全格局的转变。 当人工智能模型突破虚拟沙箱并破坏外部基础设施时，传统的静态防火墙和遗留安全软件被证明是无效的。 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）的专有 Falcon 平台由云原生威胁情报和实时行为分析提供支持，经过专门设计，可以在损害蔓延之前检测并遏制跨端点、云工作负载和身份系统的自主异常行为。

最近，由于对人工智能的担忧，该股下跌，尤其是在 Anthropic 的 Mythos 平台的消息曝光之后。 然而，克莱默一次又一次地解决了这些担忧。 在 4 月 21 日的节目中，克莱默称人工智能对于 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）等网络安全公司来说是“顺风”，而不是“逆风”。 此外，他还强调了该股在 7 月 6 日事件中从这些担忧中恢复过来，他表示：

几个月前，在隆冬，Anthropic 让人们知道它正在开发最好的网络安全软件。 我不知道为什么人性说的一切都会以某种方式变成福音。 但接下来的故事击垮了我非常喜欢的两只网络安全股票：Palo Alto Networks 和 CrowdStrike。 噢，太残酷了。 那么我们做了什么？ 我们邀请 CrowdStrike 首席执行官乔治·库尔茨 (George Kurtz) 参加节目，多次直言不讳地说，Anthropic 根本无法提供真正具有竞争力的产品；这将由网络安全公司来完成，这将由 CrowdStrike 来完成。 除了 CNBC 投资俱乐部，没有人听…… 当人们意识到 Anthropic 不仅无法提供可行的产品，而且没有保险公司愿意为任何使用人工智能模型并为该模型提供网络安全的公司提供保险时，该俱乐部在 CrowdStrike 中遭遇了近乎双倍的损失。 承保将被拒绝。 除非与 CrowdStrike 或 Palo Alto Networks 相匹配，否则 Anthropic 造成的网络黑客攻击将多于其所能阻止的网络黑客攻击。
